programmes.d: The gang thinks it has found the perfect tunnels to access all of Swellview, until it is confronted by the tunnels' original inhabitants.
Charlotte and Jasper must come to the rescue when Captain Man and Kid Danger are each stuck in a hole.
When Kid Danger publicly breaks his arm, Henry and the gang have to find a way to keep his secret safe.
Henry and Charlotte are in charge of protecting Swellview while Ray is out of town at his cousin's wedding.
Lincoln is unable to sleep after watching a scary movie, so he stays awake all night; when a common cold spreads through the Loud house, Lincoln believes his sisters have turned into zombies.
Lincoln tries to game the family gift swap and ends up learning a valuable lesson; a Scrooge-like Flip is visited by three ghosts in a take on "A Christmas Carol."

The Louds rent a boat for a relaxing day trip on the lake, but the family ends up marooned on a desert island; Lincoln and Clyde, as Ace and Jack, investigate when they discover a frozen food company is using Dad's recipes.

Luan tries out for the school play to get closer to her crush, Benny; when Clyde and schoolmate Zach begin bonding over a mutual interest in antiques, Lincoln quickly finds himself feeling like a third wheel.
Lincoln and Clyde find out that "ARGGH!" is coming to town; Lori moves to the garage.
Lucy becomes annoyed when Lori and Leni start watching her vampire show because of a cute new character; Mom gets community service for racking up tickets.

Lola and Lana try out for Bluebell Scouts, but discover one of them might be more suited for it; when Lincoln and Clyde think Bobby is cheating on Lori, they follow him around town gathering evidence.

All of Lincoln's sisters develop a crush on his new tutor, making it impossible for Lincoln to study; the children complain about their house, but they start to feel differently after a tornado threatens to destroy it.

Lincoln and his friends try to find another way to get to school after a run in with the eighth-grade bullies on the bus; Lincoln and Clyde are at odds when they discover there's only room for one of their grandmas at Sunset Canyon.

Convinced that their scrapbook isn't good enough for Dad's birthday, the Loud kids seek out the perfect gift; Lily hears the parents mention ice cream if the kids are good, so she uses baby smarts to avert sibling disasters.

When Dad gets upset with the children for never locking the front door, they decide to take home security to the next level; when Lincoln accidentally erases his childhood photos, he and Clyde attempt to recreate them before his memory fades.

Clyde is desperate to learn how to act normal around Lori, so he enlists Leni's help; worried that their parents are hurting their health from not being active, the children encourage them to exercise.
SpongeBob turns in a litterbug to the police; SpongeBob and Patrick buy invisible spray from the local prank shop.
Patrick gets his license and wins a car; a document reveals that Patrick is next in line to become a king.
When Rock's dad comes to town, Rock joins the family business in an attempt to finally impress his father; after receiving a glitter bomb in the mail, Rock vows revenge on the anonymous bomber.
When Pencil comes over to watch a horror movie, Paper worries he is too scared to handle it; there's a light wind, and Paper is far from home, so Rock and Scissors must try to save him.
Timmy wishes that Tom Sawyer could come out of his book and help him with his book report.
Chloe joins the Squirrely Scouts and saves the troop by helping them get their first merit badge; when Timmy and Chloe find out they have the same birthday, they decide to compete for the best party.
Foop and Poof must take care of an egg for a school project; Timmy's father becomes a news anchor when Chet Ubetcha quits his job; Timmy must get Chet back in order to save the city.
Crocker is convinced that Timmy's father is a fairy and sets out to prove it; Timmy meets his grandparents and wishes that they had never come to America.
Timmy makes a wish for Chester; Timmy becomes a girl for the day in order to think of the perfect gift for Trixie.
Wanda must run the family business when Big Daddy is kidnapped; Timmy wishes his mother could sell a house to anyone.
Timmy goes back in time to try to change Mr. Crocker's past so that he will be a happier person in the present.
Wanda gives Timmy a magic photocopier; the police mistakenly think Timmy's parents are dangerous outlaws.
Foop and Poof must take care of an egg for a school project; Timmy's father becomes a news anchor when Chet Ubetcha quits his job; Timmy must get Chet back in order to save the city.
Timmy makes a wish to be "emo" and stops caring about everything; Timmy and the fairies have to rid his home of fairy dust.
After Timmy is rejected from the school band, he wishes that everyone would love his music; Vicky is stricken by Timmy's generosity when he saves her from a horrible accident.
Chloe's favorite cartoon characters come to life and brainwash Timmy and Wanda; Timmy's enemies learn that he is helpless without his fairies and try to destroy him while he is weak.
Nasty Vicky has magic on her side and revenge on her mind; Timmy wishes for a reset button for his life so he can get do-overs.
Timmy wishes for master kung-fu skills in order to fight a bully; Timmy travels back in time and encounters a crazed witch-hunter.
Timmy wishes for the perfect older brother; Timmy wishes that everything in school were mixed up like a puzzle book.
Timmy wishes that the entire world would be quiet; Chester and A.J. are suspicious of Timmy's sudden popularity.
When Dad believes that everyone finds him boring, Timmy wishes his life was like an action movie; Timmy and his parents are invited to a country club.

Timmy discovers a plot to destroy the Crimson Chin's reputation; Timmy wishes for access to Vicky's diary.
Poof becomes unwell and accidentally turns everyone into chickens; Timmy steals Cupid's arrows in an attempt to make Trixie fall in love with him.

Chloe thinks she has a rash caused by stress and wishes to be a slacker, but Dimmsdale falls apart without her; Dad wants to catch a fish to win a trophy, but Chloe wishes all the fish could fight back.
A dragon abducts Vicky when Timmy and his friends visit the Middle Ages; Timmy's parents become superheroes.
Problems occur when Timmy leaves his Crimson Chin comic on the side of his bathtub; Timmy wishes for the height and skills of a basketball superstar.
Timmy wishes for a scholarship to military school; Timmy's father tries to help him with his homework.
After Dad rejects his offer to buy Sparky, Dad's boss makes his job miserable; Timmy wishes that his ancestors had different careers.
Timmy wishes that everything he says is right; Timmy gets to be placed with the big kids.
SpongeBob and Squidward become stranded in the desert while delivering a pizza; SpongeBob loses his pineapple home.
SpongeBob attempts to write an 800-word essay before morning; Patrick tries to impress his parents on Starfish Day.
Sandy puts SpongeBob and Patrick in charge of her pet caterpillar; SpongeBob invents colored Krabby patties.
SpongeBob thinks Mr. Krabs is a robot; SpongeBob and Patrick care for an abandoned baby clam.
Squidward finds himself in the freezer; karate sparring wreaks havoc.
Mr. Krabs turns the Krusty Krab into a hotel; SpongeBob's record of failed boating tests causes Mrs. Puff to lose her job.
The Krusty Krab employees must work around the clock; Mr. Krabs sheds his shell right before the reunion with his old seafaring buddies.
Patrick helps Squidward with his newspaper delivery job to compensate for injuring him; in the midst of a typical day of scavenging, the Dartfish family discovers a thief in the Star home.
Grandpa prevents his precious memories from being sold at a family yard sale.
Charlotte's birthday road trip to see the Boo Man Group perform gets sidetracked by a Captain Man and Kid Danger emergency.
When Piper's school parrot, Otto, starts to repeat that Henry is Kid Danger, Henry and Jasper have to stall until Ray, Charlotte and Schwoz can find a way to fix things.
When Dr. Minyak takes the Man Fans hostage, Captain Man and Kid Danger have to find a way to rescue them without Dr. Minyak seeing them move.
